source_fields_and_business_rules: BR-ACC-10: account number must be unique per owner
evidence_and_scope.change_required: Add a database-enforced composite unique constraint for Accounts(user_id, account_number_full), expose the same constraint in TypeORM entity metadata, and add an owner-scoped service precheck for a clear conflict response. The database constraint remains authoritative for concurrent requests.
out_of_scope: No public request or success-response changes
No account-number normalization or case-folding rule
No global uniqueness across different owners
No ownership, relationship, cascade, retention, or deletion changes
No automatic deletion, merge, or rewriting of existing duplicate rows
No changes to other Business Rules

columns.constraint_and_index: Composite unique constraint uq_accounts_user_id_account_number_full on (user_id, account_number_full)
columns.source_rationale: BR-ACC-10 permits the same account number for different owners but forbids duplicate account numbers belonging to one owner. A database constraint is required for race-safe enforcement.

relationships_and_ownership.statement: Ownership remains derived from the authenticated user and persisted as Accounts.user_id. The service precheck and database constraint use user_id together with account_number_full; no client-provided owner ID is accepted as authorization.

sensitive_data_and_exposure.storage_protection: The full account number remains stored under the existing schema contract; this proposal does not introduce encryption or masking-at-rest behavior absent from the frozen UC.
sensitive_data_and_exposure.default_selection: account_number_full remains excluded from account list and create response allowlists.
sensitive_data_and_exposure.logging_and_export: Do not log or export account_number_full. Duplicate conflict responses must not disclose the full number.

migration_plan.name: 1788495106545-add-accounts-owner-account-number-unique.ts
preflight: Query Accounts grouped by user_id and account_number_full and stop if any count is greater than one.
Report duplicate owner/number groups without exposing full account numbers in application logs or repair artifacts.
Require a separate researcher data-resolution decision if duplicates exist; do not delete, merge, or rewrite rows automatically.
forward_operations: Run the duplicate preflight and fail without mutation when duplicate groups exist.
Create composite unique constraint uq_accounts_user_id_account_number_full on Accounts(user_id, account_number_full).
service_behavior: Before save, perform an owner-scoped lookup using userId and accountNumberFull and return the established safe HTTP 409 conflict when found.
Retain ER_DUP_ENTRY-to-HTTP-409 mapping so a concurrent insert rejected by the database produces the same safe conflict behavior.
rollback_operations: Drop only the named uq_accounts_user_id_account_number_full constraint/index.
migration_plan.data_loss_risk: Forward and rollback operations do not delete or rewrite account data. Forward migration is deliberately blocked by existing duplicates until the researcher approves a separate data-resolution action.
migration_plan.deployment_considerations: Creating the unique index may lock or scan Accounts depending on MySQL version and table size. Apply through the configured TypeORM migration mechanism during an approved deployment window.

assumptions: The physical table and columns remain Accounts.user_id and Accounts.account_number_full as declared by the current entity mapping; renaming the legacy table is outside this repair.
Uniqueness compares the persisted account_number_full value using the database column's existing collation; normalization beyond the frozen format rule is not authorized.
The same account_number_full value may be used by different authenticated owners because BR-ACC-10 is owner-scoped.
A service precheck improves the normal conflict path but does not replace the composite unique constraint required for concurrency safety.
No cascade, foreign-key, nullability, length, precision, or default changes are required.

approval.approved_via: researcher confirmation in active Codex session
